_メモ: 2026-11-17 作成。香山道路の鉄骨組立大工（鉄骨住宅組立工事部）・特定技能1号の求人票（2026年7月23日）から。2号は募集しない（井村さん）。採用予定「男2人」は性別を限らないよう「2人」と表示。賃金は日給に○だが日額の記載なし→基本給186,953円（月）と職能手当5万〜15万で表示。総支給296,900〜346,900・手取り22万〜29万は求人票どおり。寮は求人票では住居費1万＋水道光熱費実費だが、井村さんの指示（香山寮は月1万円・水道光熱費込み）に合わせた→要確認。学歴「高等専門学校」に○・運転免許は項目名に○で、意図が分からないため載せていない→要確認。日本語はN3に○。退職金は30年500万のみ記載（35年の記載なし）。一戸建て・出産祝いはこの求人票には無いので載せない

name.ja: 香山道路株式会社{かやまどうろかぶしきがいしゃ}

business.en:
"A company that creates roads, towns and the future." Based in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka, it does civil engineering, exterior construction and paving work.
The company has three departments:
- Civil engineering construction
- Steel-frame house assembly
- Formwork and house foundations
The company owns heavy machines such as asphalt finishers, rollers and backhoes (hydraulic excavators).

description.en:
Work in the steel-frame house assembly department. You will assemble apartments and houses with steel frames.
The work includes apartment and house construction, and light-gauge steel work (making the base for ceilings and walls with light steel).

A day: 7:00 meet at the office -> 8:00 at the site, morning meeting -> work -> 12:00-13:00 lunch break -> work -> 17:00 return to the office

The team: president -> work supervisor -> regular staff -> Specified Skilled Workers and Technical Intern Trainees.
You can see the company and its heavy machines in the video below.
